eps.o: When Cecil's boss visits the house, the Stars get trapped in a sitcom.
When Squidina is bedridden, Patrick has to run his show without her.
GrandPat competes for Granny Tentacles' love on a dating game show.
The Ice Cream Man and Ice Cream King team up to capture a mysterious ice cream eating beast.
Tinkle stumbles into a time-traveling adventure.
Patrick and Squidina aren't allowed to watch TV when they spend time with their parents for a day.
When Granny Tentacles goes out for a spa day, Patrick and Squidina take care of her house.
After Plankton forgets who he is, the Dartfish family adopts him.
Patrick and Squidina help the Flim-Flam brothers hunt the ghost that haunts their house.
On her day off from the Patrick Show, Squidina helps Rube produce his TV show.
Patrick hosts a countrified variety show.
The Kelpbed Kids travel to the future to get their kicking can back.
The Star family goes on a college tour for Patrick… at the zoo.
GrandPat shares his life stories to spoil every movie at the theater.
The Patricks compete in a series of games for control of the TV remote.
After driving over Patrick, a court order forces Lady Upturn to live with the Star family.
The Stars watch a series of haunted video tapes.
For Leif Erikson Day, Patrick and SpongeBob time-travel back to Viking times.
When the Stars go to the mountains, Squidina hires Plankton to entertain the Lawnies.
Quasar uses Patrick to communicate with the dumbest aliens in the universe.
Patrick and GrandPat have a staring contest to compete for the last lick of a baking spoon.
After yet another Star house disaster, the fire marshal forces Patrick to watch a safety training video.
Patrick fails his way up the corporate ladder at Upturn's mall.
After accidentally putting on doctor's clothes, Patrick believes he's a medical professional.
After Pearl can no longer have a sleepover with Squidina, the Stars throw Squidina a slumber party on their own.
